description: The records a resolver serves from its local data, host overrides among them: stored by the provider plugin as observations (plugin_unbound.resource_record_observation, ADR 0020 wave 4); A, AAAA and PTR records are kept, every other type counted.

cadences.basis: Decision 4 of specs/SPEC-resolver-cache-attribution.md: local data is configuration -- host overrides, registered leases -- and changes on the scale of minutes to hours, like the leases it is read beside.

functions.description: Called at every probe round: asks the firewall whether this implementation can be read and whether its configuration serves clients.
functions.name: probe

functions.description: Called at every pass: reads the resolver and answers one row per record for the provider's own tables.
functions.name: collect

fields.description: Why the probe could not finish, when it could not.
fields.name: error

fields.description: The rows to store, by table of the provider's own.
fields.name: rows

fields.description: The provider's durable state for the next pass.
fields.name: state

fields.description: The collection gaps the pass detected, each {from, to, reason, detail}.
fields.name: gaps

fields.description: Why the read failed, when it did; the result then says what the firewall answered.
